headlines.title: Emery takes positives, but Villa 'have work to do' to reach Barca level
headlines.description: Aston Villa boss Unai Emery says his team have "work to do" to reach Barcelona's level after a 3-0 Champions League defeat at the Nou Camp.

headlines.title: Saliba's back for Arsenal - how does Arteta solve his defensive dilemma?
headlines.description: William Saliba returning to first-team training before Arsenal's game with Slavia Prague in the Champions League is a huge boost for the club but now presents Mikel Arteta with a selection headache.

headlines.title: Man Utd eye Man City's Ait-Nouri - Wednesday's gossip
headlines.description: Manchester City defender Rayan Ait-Nouri a surprise target for Manchester United, Crystal Palace could turn to England assistant boss Anthony Barry if they sack Pierre Sage, Barcelona keen on Arsenal centre-back Piero Hincapie, plus more.
